codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: The questions chat answers every single day

items.question: Is How to Fish really about fishing?
items.answer: About one third of it. The rod is the opening act; survival management, improvised weapons and a suspiciously lucrative casino carry the rest.

items.question: Can I play solo?
items.answer: Yes — the game scales swarm sizes and boss health, but the community consensus is that a 3–4 person crew makes Island 3 dramatically less painful.

items.question: What should I buy first?
items.answer: The bright spinner lure, then the second grill slot, then the shotgun. Lures pay for weapons, never the reverse — the full order is in the Arsenal & Lures guide.

items.question: Where is the save file?
items.answer: Under your local app data folder in the game's directory (AppData/LocalLow on Windows). Copy the whole folder somewhere safe before experimenting — the Fix-It Desk has exact steps.

items.question: Do fish despawn if I leave them hooked?
items.answer: Hooked fish never despawn, but they tire and escape chance rises after about 90 seconds. Parked schools, however, do rotate — dock parking spots are first-come, first-served.

items.question: How do I catch the Drippy Urchin?
items.answer: Golden hook, Island 4 reef shelf, and the charm slot empty. It only spawns while you are not actively looking at the water — the community remains furious about this.

items.question: Is Hard mode worth it?
items.answer: Payouts run about 40% fatter and two achievements live there. Swarm pressure also arrives a day early, so only bring Hard mode once the shotgun purchase is muscle memory.

items.question: Is this site official?
items.answer: No. HowToFish Hub is a fan-made reference, not affiliated with the developer. It exists because the community kept answering the same six questions in chat every day.
